description: Synthetic checkpoint report vectors for chapter 2 of the executor protocol: one grant, one scenario, the report sent for it and what it settles, for every row of section 2.8, and reports section 2.9 refuses. Every id is made up and every key is public test material that authenticates nothing anywhere.

attestation-altered-after-signing.fault: An attestation whose claims were changed after they were signed.

attestation-before-the-grant.fault: An attestation dated a second before the second the grant was issued in.

attestation-contradicts-the-body.fault: The body says the executor cancelled and its attestation says the vendor executed.

attestation-for-another-operation.fault: An attestation that binds another operation than the grant's.

attestation-outside-the-ring.fault: An attestation signed by a key the ring does not hold, under a key id it does.

attestation-under-the-ed25519-key.fault: An attestation naming the ring's Ed25519 key, which verifies only its own scheme.

fractional-number.fault: The body writes a number with a fraction.

journal-as-a-record.fault: A provider's journal presented as the executor's own record.

journal-before-the-grant.fault: A journal dated a microsecond before the grant, inside the second it was issued in: a journal is compared with the grant's exact instant, not its second.

journal-contradicts-the-body.fault: The body says EXECUTED and the provider's journal says the target was not found.

journal-for-another-command.fault: A journal of a command at another expected version than the grant's.

journal-under-an-unavailable-grant.fault: A provider's journal of the command ExecBound would have sent, for a grant under UNAVAILABLE: such a grant carries no provider command, so no journal binds it.

journal-under-another-key.fault: A journal signed under a journal key nobody configured.

no-evidence.fault: A terminal outcome with neither a reported time nor signed evidence.

record-altered-after-signing.fault: A record whose statement was changed after it was signed.

record-as-a-journal.fault: The executor's own record presented as a provider's journal.

record-before-the-grant.fault: A record dated a second before the second the grant was issued in.

record-contradicts-the-body.fault: The body says EXECUTED and its signed record says the target was not found.

record-for-another-operation.fault: A record that binds another operation than the grant's.

record-outside-the-ring.fault: A record signed by a key the ring does not hold, under a key id it does.

record-under-the-es256-key.fault: An Ed25519 record naming the ring's ES256 key, which verifies only its own scheme.

record-unregistered-key-id.fault: A record signed under a key id the ring does not hold.

reported-failure-refunding.fault: REPORTED_FAILURE beside FAILED_NOT_EXECUTED, the outcome that refunds.

signed-reported-failure.fault: REPORTED_FAILURE beside signed evidence, which can state no such reason.

stored-attestation-as-a-record.fault: An ES256 attestation in the flattened form a settlement stores, presented as a record: a record is an Ed25519 signed outcome, and ES256 arrives only as an attestation.

time-beside-evidence.fault: A reported time beside a signed record.

two-pieces-of-evidence.fault: A signed record and an attestation of the same statement, together.

unknown-field.fault: The body names a field the report does not, a tier of its own choosing.

unknown-with-a-reason.fault: UNKNOWN reported as though it were terminal, with a reason.

asserted-cancelled.scenario: The executor decided not to act and never called the vendor, and the executor says so without signing.

asserted-executed.scenario: The vendor performed the action, and the executor says so without signing.

asserted-reported-failure.scenario: The vendor call failed, and whether the vendor acted is not established.

asserted-target-not-found.scenario: The vendor holds no such target, and the executor says so without signing.

asserted-version-mismatch.scenario: The vendor refused the conditional write: the target was no longer at the expected version, and the executor says so without signing.

attestation-cancelled.scenario: The executor decided not to act and never called the vendor, and the executor signs an ES256 attestation.

attestation-executed.scenario: The vendor performed the action, and the executor signs an ES256 attestation.

attestation-executed-in-the-grants-secon.scenario: The vendor performed the action, and the executor, which signs whole seconds only, signs an ES256 attestation dated at the start of the second the grant was issued in, before the grant's exact instant.

attestation-target-not-found.scenario: The vendor holds no such target, and the executor signs an ES256 attestation.

attestation-version-mismatch.scenario: The vendor refused the conditional write: the target was no longer at the expected version, and the executor signs an ES256 attestation.

class-asserted-by-executor-asserted-vers.scenario: The grant's class is ASSERTED_BY_EXECUTOR: the executor found the target no longer at the expected version and did not act, and says so without signing.

class-asserted-by-executor-record-versio.scenario: The grant's class is ASSERTED_BY_EXECUTOR: the executor read the target, found it no longer at the expected version and did not act, and signs that with its Ed25519 key.

class-unavailable-asserted-executed.scenario: The grant's class is UNAVAILABLE; the vendor performed the action, and the executor says so without signing.

class-unavailable-attestation-executed.scenario: The grant's class is UNAVAILABLE, so it carries no version and no provider command; the vendor performed the action, and the executor signs an ES256 attestation.

journal-cancelled.scenario: The executor cancelled the operation at the vendor before dispatching it, and relays the provider's cancellation tombstone: its signed journal of the grant's provider command, recording that nothing was executed.

journal-executed.scenario: The vendor performed the action, and the vendor speaks chapter 1 and answered the grant's provider command with its signed journal, which the executor relays.

journal-target-not-found.scenario: The vendor holds no such target, and the vendor speaks chapter 1 and answered the grant's provider command with its signed journal, which the executor relays.

journal-version-mismatch.scenario: The vendor refused the conditional write: the target was no longer at the expected version, and the vendor speaks chapter 1 and answered the grant's provider command with its signed journal, which the executor relays.

record-cancelled.scenario: The executor decided not to act and never called the vendor, and the executor signs a record with its Ed25519 key.

record-executed.scenario: The vendor performed the action, and the executor signs a record with its Ed25519 key.

record-executed-in-the-grants-second.scenario: The vendor performed the action, and the executor, which signs whole seconds only, signs a record with its Ed25519 key dated at the start of the second the grant was issued in, before the grant's exact instant.

record-target-not-found.scenario: The vendor holds no such target, and the executor signs a record with its Ed25519 key.

record-version-mismatch.scenario: The vendor refused the conditional write: the target was no longer at the expected version, and the executor signs a record with its Ed25519 key.

unknown.scenario: The vendor call timed out, and the executor does not know whether the vendor acted.
